2115034079854821555.en_summary: @jonnajarian: $FER (Ferrovial) is up 7.7% to $54.24 after clarifying payment terms on its Tennessee I-24 toll-lane concession, easing the main worry behind its slide. It reports after the close today.

2115060985396670793.en_summary: @aleabitoreddit (reply) sees hyperscalers behaving like VCs: once one secures long-term agreements for memory or lasers with $LITE, the rest pile in so their allocation isn't crowded out. $NVDA is usually first, but hyperscalers with supply-chain visibility may move first themselves.
2115060985396670793.zh_summary: @aleabitoreddit（回覆）認為超大規模雲端業者行為類似風險投資：只要有一家與$LITE簽訂記憶體或雷射的長期協議，其他業者便會跟進，以免配額被擠占。通常$NVDA會率先行動，但掌握供應鏈情況的雲端業者可能自己搶先。

ticker_notes.LITE: 雲端業者可能爭相簽長期供貨協議
